text:
maria: Heads up — found a high-severity package vuln coming from ubuntu:20.04 in a few runtime containers (CVE-2025-9999). We should do a coordinated base-image rebuild + minimal hardening pass. Proposing Tue 2025-11-25 02:00 UTC maintenance window. Need eng-runtime + infra + compliance alignment.

alex: Ack. Can you paste which images are affected and whether we can just bump to 22.04 or need distro patching?

maria: Affected: runtime-main, runtime-redis-sidecar, metrics-exporter. Quick triage shows the vulnerable package is libssl from the base. Bumping to ubuntu:22.04 drops the vuln in our scans, but we should also run an updated apt-get hardening step and drop extra packages.

kevin: We should consider image signing + KMS key rotation as part of this. If builds are automated by CI, we can rotate the signing key after the push — will need roles for the builder SA. I can prepare Terraform changes for a new service account 'image-builder' with limited perms.

tia: From compliance: need audit logs that show which key signed which image, and retention for 1yr. Also need RBAC change review for granting push/sign rights. No full admin roles.

sam: For devex — we should make the rebuild idempotent and provide a single `make` target that does: build, scan, sign, push, and create a release-tag. That makes rollbacks easier. Example: `make rebuild-base-images TAG=2025-11-25`

alex: Proposed minimal Dockerfile diff for hardening:
```
FROM ubuntu:22.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates tzdata 
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# remove package managers/unused tools, create runtime user
RUN useradd -m app && chown -R app /home/app
USER app
```

maria: Also add image scan step with Trivy and fail build on high severity. We should keep medium as warning for now.

ci-bot: Build matrix queued: runtime-main, runtime-redis-sidecar, metrics-exporter. Scans will run after build step.

kevin: For IAM: image-builder SA will get roles/storage.objectAdmin on the specific GCR bucket + roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the image-signing key. No compute or org-level rights. I'll open a PR for terraform changes.

tia: For audit logging: ensure Cloud Audit Logs for KMS are retained and exported to our secure logging project. Add an alert if signing key used outside the build pipeline.

alex: For runtime rollout: suggest canary to 5% traffic for 30m then 25% for 30m, then full. Auto rollback if error rate increases >1% or latency p50 regresses >100ms. Can we add automatic circuit-breaker?

ops-oncall: We'll add a runbook entry and be on standby during the window. Post-deploy checks: error rate, 5-minute p95, and auth failures.

sam: Devex will add a `--dry-run` flag to the make target and a smoke test script that hits health endpoints.

maria: RBAC change request: create a short-lived permission granting flow — image-builder SA gets push/sign for the rebuild window only, then we reduce to read-only afterward. kevin can you implement?

kevin: Yes. Terraform + IAM bindings will be timebound via our scheduled job (IAC will apply grant, then remove after 4 hours). I'll include the schedule in the PR.

maria: Final checklist I propose:
- Prepare upgraded Dockerfiles for affected images (alex)
- CI make target + Trivy scan + sign step (sam + ci-bot)
- Create image-builder SA + timebound IAM (kevin)
- KMS key audit export & alert (tia + kevin)
- Canary rollout plan + rollback thresholds (alex + ops-oncall)
- Post-mortem template & vuln tracking ticket (maria)

alex: I can have Dockerfile diffs and canary config in a branch by EOD tomorrow.

kevin: I'll open the terraform PR today and tag infra-owners. Will add a `README` with exact IAM roles: roles/storage.objectAdmin (scoped to bucket), roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter (scoped to key).

tia: I'll prepare compliance sign-off checklist and policy notes. Need to see the audit log export config before finalize.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window recorded: 2025-11-25T02:00:00Z - 2025-11-25T06:00:00Z. Automatic holds if pipeline detects failed scans.

maria: Great. We'll follow this plan — I'll create the tracking ticket and assign owners to each checklist item. Please report blockers in this thread. :thumbsup:

alex: Noted, ping me if you need a canary traffic tag or extra metrics exported.

kevin: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/452 (WIP)

maria: Thanks all — closing the coordination loop.
